title.es: Casa del alquimista, obra de concurso
title.pt: Casa do alquimista, trabalho de concurso

generated.description: A tall, narrow spruce and stone brick house built as a contest entry, styled as an alchemist's home with a cobweb-draped, overgrown look. It is about 36 by 36 blocks across and 97 blocks high, using roughly 11,000 blocks of spruce planks, dirt, stone bricks, and cobwebs, with a small water feature, sugar cane, and oak leaves. Inside are an enchanting table, bookshelves, an anvil, hoppers, signs, and flower pots, with glowstone for light.
